description: Affordable commercial-grade bakeware for your home

Developed exclusively for Topenca, our commercial-quality Springform 10” Pan meets the highest standards for performance and durability. It is constructed with the same features found in the best pans in the industry, so you can turn out professional-looking desserts in your home kitchen.

Thick aluminized steel offers superior heat transfer and rust resistance, while the textured surface allows airflow for beautifully even overall results. The fluted sides maximize strength, and they resist warping and denting that can occur from repeated use. The eco-friendly nonstick coating is specially formulated for baking, and it contains no PTFEs or PFOAs. No other surface releases food and cleans up more easily than our Topenca Springform 9” Pan.
Suitable for a wide variety of baking needs

The sturdiness of our Springform Pan makes it ideal for heavy concoctions like quiches and fruit tarts, and gentle enough for delicate cheesecakes, icecream cakes and 7-layer dips. You can transport your masterpiece in the pan, remove the Springform sides, and decorate your cake on-sight. Then use the pan bottom as a serving dish. One pan. No problems.
